summary: Full ASM walk of wpcmk.ovr character-creation overlay. Key findings: (1) wpcmk does NOT read newgame.dbs — no INT 21h calls anywhere in the file, no database filenames present; (2) race base stat tables live in wroot DGROUP BSS at 0x52d9..0x5333 (11 races × 9 bytes), populated at runtime by winit startup code; (3) class requirement encoding uses subtract-65 (not subtract-64 as prior pass claimed) — verified at file 0x2c7b: 'add ax, 0xffbf'; (4) creation master flow documented with 14 sequential steps and all major DGROUP variables; (5) skill availability bitmaps confirmed for all 14 classes at 0x5cb8–0x5e93, cross-validated against stock characters.

corrections.correction: ASM at file 0x2c7b: 'add ax, 0xffbf' = subtract 65 (0x41). 'A'=0, 'M'=12. Fighter req 'MAAAAAAA' = STR>=12 (not 13 as prior pass claimed). Also at 0x2cae: class_qualification_check uses same subtract-65.

corrections.prior_claim: Task hypothesis: wpcmk reads from newgame.dbs for fresh character data
corrections.correction: wpcmk.ovr contains zero INT 21h (CD 21) opcodes — confirmed by byte scan returning 0 matches. No strings 'newgame', 'scenario', 'MASTER' appear in the file. wpcmk does NO file I/O. The only filename strings are 'PCFILE.DBS' (roster) at 0x5ca9 and 0x60b9, and portrait templates 'WPORT1.EGA' (0x608d), 'WPORT1.CGA' (0x6098), 'WPORT1.T16' (0x60ae). Race data originates in DGROUP BSS, loaded by winit state-0.
corrections.evidence: python byte scan: data.count(b'\xcd\x21') == 0 on 24793-byte wpcmk.ovr

findings.claim: wpcmk.ovr dispatch stub at file 0x10 is a no-op: pops a return address, sets *0x363a=4 (return to wbase main menu state 4), sets ax=0, returns. The character-creation UI is invoked as cross-overlay calls from wbase, not via the state machine.

evidence.disasm: pop cx; mov word [0x363a],4; mov ax,0; ret

findings.claim: wpcmk_create_character_master at file 0x4e47 is the top-level creation orchestrator, called from wbase slot 5. It executes 14 sequential stages.

stages.action: memset 0x5470 (char record buffer, 0x1b0=432 bytes) to zero
copy roster slot data into 0x5470 (via roster_read thunk, push slot, push 0x5470)
stages.notes: Only relevant if slot has existing data; for empty slot this copies zeros

stages.action: call 0x0d13 (creation_ui_init): sets up 3 UI windows via calls to ui_window_create thunk
call 0x0df7 (char_sheet_redraw): full character sheet redraw
set [0x56ac] = 0xffff (bonus_points = -1, sentinel for 'not yet rolled')
call 0x2b04 (stat_panel_render): renders attribute panel with current stats
stages.notes: Called before race pick; shows base-zero stats at this point

stages.action: call 0x308d (race_picker_menu): interactive race selection, sets race in [0x560d], bumps [0x559c..0x55a3] to racial minimums via stats_bump_to_racial_minimums at 0x2c7b
bss_writes: DGROUP 0x559c..0x55a3: base_stats[8] bumped to racial minimums

stages.action: call 0x31a6 (class_picker_menu): interactive class selection with qualification checks, sets class in char record
BONUS ROLLER: bonus = 5 + rng(6); if rng(20)==0: bonus+=8; if rng(20)==0: bonus+=8; if [0x56ce]==1: bonus=21 (debug override); write to [0x56ac]
bss_writes: DGROUP 0x56ce: debug_cheat_flag (read; if==1, sets bonus to 21=0x15)

stages.action: call 0x2b04 (stat_panel_render): re-renders attribute panel (now with racial minimums + bonus total visible)
call 0x32e1 (attribute_roll_display): triggers attribute rolling animation
call 0x3405 (bonus_allocator_ui): player distributes bonus points; 4-way nav (LEFT/RIGHT +/-, UP/DOWN attr select, key 5 confirm); each attr caps at 18; confirm gated on pool==0
bss_writes: DGROUP 0x559c..0x55a3: base_stats[8] updated by bonus allocation
DGROUP 0x56ac: decremented as points are spent

stages.action: call 0x3837 (personality_reroll_loop): dice animation; rolls [0x55a3] each iteration; exits on mouse-click or RETURN
bss_writes: DGROUP 0x55a3: karma/personality stat set by final roll value

stages.action: call 0x392e (alignment_picker): alignment selection menu
mov [0x560c], 0 (reset name-entry flag)
call 0x4bad (name_entry): character name input via text editor widget
call 0x3c49 (portrait_picker): portrait file loader + picker loop
call 0x0df7 (char_sheet_redraw): final character sheet redraw
if [0x5618] != 0: call 0x1ae9 with [0x56ca] (spell_school_init: 14 schools per-class allocation)
skill training loop: iterate 4 pillars (MAGIC/FAITH/PHYSICAL/MENTAL), call skill_train at 0x28d4 for each pillar with [0x546e] window handle and [0x56ca] char record
stages.bytes: c7 46 fe 00 00 (init loop counter to 0); 80 bf 88 55 00 (check [si+0x5588] != 0); e8 cc d9 (call 0x28d4)
stages.notes: Loop index [bp-2] from 0 to 3; [si+0x5588] = pillar_has_skills flag

stages.action: call 0x1b (roster_write_slot): write char record to PCFILE.DBS at slot [bp+6]
mark roster slot occupied: [bx+0x4fd8] = 1 where bx = slot_index
call 0xf0dc (roster_save_all): flush full roster to disk

findings.claim: 11 races indexed 0..10. Race stat floor tables at DGROUP BSS 0x52d9..0x5333 (stride=9 bytes each). Ordering confirmed by cross-referencing stock character race bytes in pcfile.dbs.

evidence.source: race init dispatch at file 0x2fce: 11 push-then-call 0x2c7b blocks, each pushing a distinct DGROUP BSS address

race_index_map.2: Dwarf (inferred by position; no stock char to confirm)
race_index_map.5: Faerie (inferred; confirmed by wpcvw AC -2 for race=5)

findings.claim: Race base stat tables at DGROUP 0x52d9..0x5333 are in wroot BSS (zero-filled at startup), populated at runtime by database-loading code (likely winit state-0). These addresses are BEYOND wroot.exe file end: wroot.exe is 0x1063e bytes, DGROUP file start = 0x200 + 0xfd8*16 = 0xff80; DGROUP offset 0x52d9 = file offset 0x152b9 > 0x1063e.
findings.implication: To decode race stat floors from newgame.dbs, we need to trace winit state-0 database loading to find the DGROUP load base address, then compute file offset = load_base - 0x52d9 (relative to newgame.dbs start).

findings.claim: stats_bump_to_racial_minimums at file 0x2c7b: for si=0..7, reads current_stat=[si+0x559c], reads raw_race_min=[bx+si] (bx=race_table_ptr), computes threshold=raw_race_min-65 via 'add ax,0xffbf'. If current_stat < threshold, sets [si+0x559c] = raw_race_min - 65. This is a FLOOR operation: stat is raised to racial minimum, never lowered.

Class requirement table at file 0x5e98: 14 entries × 9 bytes each. Null-terminated 8-char ASCII strings, encoding: char-65 = minimum attribute value. Verified formula against stats_bump at 0x2c7b (same subtract-65). All 14 class requirements decoded.

cross_validation.NOBAL_Priest: attrs=[7,10,13,9,9,9,8,4]; priest requires PIE>=12(has 13 OK), PER>=8(has 8 OK) -> PASS
cross_validation.PENTAG_Mage: attrs=[10,12,13,10,8,6,6,9]; mage requires INT>=12(has 12 OK) -> PASS

findings.claim: 14 class skill availability bitmaps at file 0x5cb8..0x5e93. Each class has 4 null-terminated ASCII digit strings ('0'/'1' per skill), encoding 30 trainable-skill bits. bit[i]=1 means class can train skill i.

evidence.structure: 14 class groups, each 4 null-terminated strings concatenated (groups of 10+7+5+8=30 bits)

cross_validation.NOBAL_Priest_class2: bitmap[2][4]=1(trainable), stock skill[4]=2; bitmap[2][8]=1(trainable), stock skill[8]=2 -> PASS

evidence.note: Skill index names (0..29) not yet decoded. From stock chars: skill[0]=likely_sword/weapon?, skill[1]=likely_sword_high?, skill[4]=likely_bow_or_magic?, skill[8]=likely_bow?. Requires wpcmk 4-pillar skill_train table decode.

findings.claim: Key DGROUP BSS variables read/written by wpcmk during character creation.

variables.0x546e: ui_window_handle (window created at game start, passed to all render calls)
variables.0x5470: new_char_record_buffer (432 bytes, 0x1b0, cleared at creation start; holds character being created)
variables.0x5488: secondary_window_handle (used in stat display context at 0x2bbd)
variables.0x5588: pillar_has_skills_flags (4 bytes at +0..+3, checked in skill training loop at 0x4eef)
variables.0x559c..0x55a3: base_stats[8]: STR/INT/PIE/VIT/DEX/SPD/PER/KAR during creation; bumped by racial minimums at 0x2c7b, further modified by bonus allocator
variables.0x560c: name_entry_flag (cleared to 0 before name entry at 0x4ed0)
variables.0x5618: spell_count_or_has_spells (if != 0, spell school init runs at 0x4ede)
variables.0x56ac: bonus_points_remaining (0xffff=unset, 5..26 after roller, decremented by allocator)
variables.0x56ae: class_qualification_flags (word per class, set by class_check at 0x2cae; bx=class_idx*2)
variables.0x56ca: char_record_ptr (pointer to character record in creation; used in spell/skill calls)
variables.0x4fd8: roster_occupancy_array (one byte per slot; [slot]=1 when slot filled at 0x4fb4)
variables.0x52d9..0x5333: race_stat_floor_tables[11][9] in wroot BSS (zero-filled; populated at runtime by winit from newgame.dbs or similar database)

findings.claim: wpcmk.ovr contains zero INT 21h (CD 21) DOS syscall instructions. All file I/O is done via cross-overlay thunk calls to wroot file I/O functions. The only filename strings in wpcmk.ovr are PCFILE.DBS (roster) and portrait templates. No scenario, newgame, or master database filenames exist in this overlay.
Portrait picker at file 0x4a9a (previously documented). Filename templates at 0x608d: WPORT1.EGA (0x608d), WPORT1.CGA (0x6098), WPORT1.T16 (0x60ae). 3 video-mode-keyed templates × N portraits each.

unresolved: Race stat floor values: the actual minimum attribute values per race are in DGROUP BSS 0x52d9..0x5333, populated at runtime. To decode them statically, trace winit state-0 to find where newgame.dbs (or equivalent) is loaded into DGROUP and what the load base address is.
Skill index names: which of the 30 skill bits corresponds to which skill name. Requires decoding the 4-pillar skill_train table at wpcmk 0x28d4.
Race 2/4/5/6/9 confirmation: inferred as Dwarf/Hobbit/Faerie/Lizardman/Rawulf from position, but no stock characters have these races to confirm against pcfile.dbs.
Alignment picker at 0x392e: not traced in detail; alignment byte location in character record not confirmed from this pass (expected near race/class at +0x19d area).

The jump table at CS:0x75ab in wpcmk's race dispatch: address is beyond file end (0x60d9), indicating it lives in wpcmk's BSS region and is populated at load time by the overlay relocation fixer. The table entries would be pointers to handlers 0x2fd7..0x303d. This does not affect any of the above findings.

Decode skill_train 4-pillar table at wpcmk 0x28d4 to name all 30 skill bits
Verify Dwarf/Hobbit/Faerie/Lizardman/Rawulf race indices via dynamic trace or newgame.dbs decode
